Reference › C API

C API

The header is pare.h. For a walkthrough see Using libpare from C and other languages.

Functions

c 
int32_t     pare_strip(const char *source, size_t length, uint32_t options, pare_result *result);
void        pare_free(pare_result *result);
const char *pare_message(int32_t code);
const char *pare_hint(int32_t code);
const char *pare_version(void);
uint32_t    pare_abi_version(void);

pare_strip

Strips length bytes of UTF-8 TypeScript at source. NULL with length 0 is the empty source. A leading BOM is dropped. Free *result with pare_free whatever the return value.

Return Name Meaning
0 PARE_OK stripped; result->output holds the JavaScript
1 PARE_REJECTED syntax error or non-erasable syntax; see result->diagnostics
2 PARE_INVALID NULL result, NULL source with length > 0, unknown option bits, invalid UTF-8, or length over 2,147,483,591 bytes; nothing allocated
3 PARE_INTERNAL a bug in Pare; nothing allocated

Options

Flag Does
PARE_REWRITE_RELATIVE_IMPORT_EXTENSIONS (1) rewrites relative ./x.ts imports to ./x.js (.mts and .cts likewise), as TypeScript's rewriteRelativeImportExtensions does

Pass 0 for no options. Unknown bits return PARE_INVALID.

Types

c 
typedef struct pare_diagnostic {
    int32_t code;    /* 1 syntax error; 100-107 non-erasable syntax */
    int32_t line;    /* 1-based */
    int32_t column;  /* 1-based, in UTF-16 code units */
    int32_t start;   /* byte offset into the source passed in */
    int32_t length;  /* bytes */
} pare_diagnostic;

typedef struct pare_result {
    char *output;                  /* UTF-8, NUL-terminated, no BOM; NULL unless PARE_OK */
    size_t output_length;          /* bytes, without the NUL */
    pare_diagnostic *diagnostics;  /* in source order; NULL when there are none */
    size_t diagnostic_count;
} pare_result;

pare_diagnostic is five int32_t, 20 bytes with no padding. output_length is never more than the source's length, and the output holds any NUL the source had.

Diagnostic codes are the numbers in Error codes: 1 is a syntax error and 100 to 107 are non-erasable syntax.

pare_free

Frees what pare_strip allocated and zeroes all four fields of *result. NULL or an already zeroed result is a no-op.

pare_message, pare_hint

Static strings, never freed. An unknown code gives "unknown diagnostic" and "".

pare_version, pare_abi_version

pare_version() returns the library version as a static string. pare_abi_version() returns the PARE_ABI_VERSION the library was built with. Compare it with the macro from your header to refuse a library built for another layout. It is currently 1.

Positions

Lines and UTF-16 columns are kept, so the output's line:column is the source's. Byte offsets shift when a blanked type contains non-ASCII text, because Pare writes one space per UTF-16 code unit.

Threads and loading

Every function is thread-safe. The library cannot be unloaded once loaded. Several NativeAOT libraries in one process are fine. On linux-musl-arm64, call pare_strip from a thread you created: there the main thread's stack check can misreport.
